text:
Maya (Marketing): quick sync — ACME Cloud listing + joint webinar + benchmark post. we need owners, high-level timeline, and inbound lead routing. can we agree owners today?
Jon P (Partnerships): I can own partner comms + marketplace listing copy. ETA for draft: Tue EOD. @Maya can you own the landing copy? :+1:
Maya (Marketing): yes i’ll take landing copy + social snippets. Can someone own webinar ops (registration, invites, replay flow)?
Carmen (Demand Gen): I’ll run webinar ops and handle registration list + nurture. need the speaker line and 2 promo emails by Wed noon.
Sam (Product Marketing): i'll handle the benchmark narrative + one-pager. want to align on the workload we'll benchmark (search latency, cost/TB, reranking improvement). propose: demo app + 100k-query synthetic workload.
Lucas (DevRel): i can produce the demo app and a short walkthrough video. Need model and infra specs from eng — @Jon can you coordinate with their eng contact?
Jon P (Partnerships): looping acme eng contact Ravi on this in DM. timeline looks tight but doable.
Priya (Sales Ops): for inbound lead routing: propose two buckets — "hot demo" (registers + asks for POC) -> SDR queue, and "content nurture" -> MQL nurture. Carmen, can you export registration fields: company size, role, interest?
Carmen (Demand Gen): yep will include company size, role, cloud provider, interest checkbox (demo, pricing, security).
Maya (Marketing): messaging iteration plan: initial draft -> partner review -> 1 round of edits -> final. want to lock messaging by Thu so creative can start on Friday.
Sam (Product Marketing): benchmark narrative quick note: we should call out cost per 1k tokens and 99th p99 latency; include method appendix. i'll draft template and share in the doc.
Lucas (DevRel): also to reduce confusion, i'll add a tiny README for reproducing the benchmark in the repo. link to repo will go in the landing page.
Priya (Sales Ops): ops question — how will leads from marketplace be tagged? need a UTM + a lead source code so we auto-route. Carmen, add hidden UTM param on registration flow?
Carmen (Demand Gen): yes will append utm_source=acme_marketplace and utm_campaign=acme_webinar_v1; will include hidden field lead_source=acme_marketplace.
Maya (Marketing): quick asset checklist so we don't miss anything: landing copy (me), marketplace listing (Jon), benchmark one-pager (Sam), demo app + walkthrough (Lucas), webinar emails (Carmen), tracking + routing (Priya).
Jon P (Partnerships): agree. I'll also draft partner co-branded slide for the webinar.
Sam (Product Marketing): deadline check: if we lock messaging Thu, i can have benchmark draft Fri morning.
Carmen (Demand Gen): i'll draft promo emails and a 3-touch nurture flow by Fri as well.
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar scheduled draft for 2024-06-12 10:00 PT. Calendar invite created.
Priya (Sales Ops): final note on routing — let's add a one-click POC request checkbox that tags leads as "hot". Carmen pls surface in registration form.
Maya (Marketing): perfect. next micro-deadlines: owners confirm by EOD today; drafts due Tue/Wed as noted. I'll collate into one Launch Playbook doc and share link here. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
